sections.title: Proof of Marton's tensorization
sections.summary: Marton's product-space tensorization of transport inequalities, including the conditional-coupling induction and KL chain rule.

sections.title: Concentration of measure
sections.summary: Mean/median equivalence, Orlicz norms, the Herbst argument, and transport-inequality characterizations of concentration.
items: §1.2.1 Equivalence between the mean and the median

sections.title: Tensorization and Gozlan's theorem
sections.summary: Dimension-free concentration through tensorization and the converse route from product-space concentration to T2.

sections.title: Metric measure spaces
sections.summary: Metric geometry, Alexandrov curvature, Lott-Sturm-Villani synthetic Ricci curvature, measured Gromov-Hausdorff stability, and comparison with the Bakry-Emery viewpoint.

sections.title: Exercises
sections.summary: Exercises fill additional proof details and connect the supplement to standard concentration inequalities.
